notes.title: Performance optimization
notes.notes: During the testing phase, I found that Unreal 5 had high performance requirements for the graphics card. In order to better match your hardware configuration, I made a lower adjustment to the display effect of the game, removing light chase and model details. After testing this version, even RTX-10 series graphics cards can adjust the screen Settings to smoothly run the game.
